title: Pushing a bit onto the stack
statement: Let $x$ be a finite bit string, let $B,k,S,p$ be natural numbers, and let $b$ be a Boolean. If $p\le B$, $2S+1\le B$, and $k+1\le B$, then the seven-register program has a run, with its specified oracle, from the push state carrying $b$ and register values $(k,S,p,0,0,0,0)$ to the node state with register values $(k+1,2S+b,0,0,0,0,0)$. Every configuration strictly before the endpoint satisfies the program precondition and has all register values at most $B$.
replaced:
Let $x$ be a bit string and let $B,k,S,p$ be natural numbers. For either Boolean value
$b$, if $p\le B$, $2S+1\le B$, and $k+1\le B$, the fixed seven-register program, with
its specified oracle, can run from the push state carrying $b$, at depth $k$, stack
value $S$, and input pointer $p$, to the node state at depth $k+1$ and stack value
$2S+b$. The input pointer and all scratch registers are zero at the endpoint; throughout
the run, every register remains at most $B$ and every configuration satisfies the
program's precondition.
